issues.issueDescription: The affected component exposes an API endpoint that fails to properly validate session tokens, allowing a remote attacker to escalate privileges and access administrative functions without valid credentials.
issues.remediationSteps: Upgrade to the patched release and rotate all active session tokens.

issues.issueDescription: A path traversal flaw in the file upload handler allows an authenticated user to write files outside the intended upload directory, potentially leading to remote code execution.
issues.remediationSteps: Apply the vendor patch and restrict upload directory permissions.

issues.issueDescription: Improper input sanitization in the search module permits a stored cross-site scripting attack that can be triggered when an administrator reviews flagged records.
issues.remediationSteps: Sanitize all user-supplied search input and encode output before rendering.
